_doc: Ground truth for the blog-agent eval harness. Each entry is a hand fix the author made to a post AFTER the pipeline published it: 'before' is the parent commit's file (what the pipeline shipped), 'after' is the commit's file (what a human wanted). Classes: rendering | citation | overclaim | ai_pattern | voice | content_loss | spelling. build_cases.py materialises these into cases/*.json so the harness runs on a shallow checkout.

classes.rendering: structure/markup integrity: fenced body, nested frontmatter, raw notes published, SVG overflow
classes.citation: wrong, missing, broken or mismatched source links
classes.overclaim: precision or certainty the source does not support
classes.ai_pattern: generated-sounding cadence: antithesis, three-beat closers, stacked contrasts, formula repeats
classes.voice: not how the author writes: employer as authority, lost credibility hook, spelling convention
classes.content_loss: sections or claims dropped by a rewrite pass

cases.note: Body wrapped in ```markdown with a second frontmatter nested inside; six source links absent
Wrong arXiv id (2609.00275 -> 2603.03515), RFC cited to a mirror instead of datatracker, aphoristic italic closer removed
Stacked not-X-but-Y, rule-of-three escalation, aphoristic closer, thesis restated 3x, 'the part that' formula x5, repeated Here's-the openers
Cut sections restored, claims re-linked to sources, weak single-source chart removed
Chart sourced to a vendor PDF that did not contain the numbers; 'doubles the cost' and 'proven over all inputs' hedged
Employer references softened; inline citation style matched
Unsupported statistic and its chart removed; 1:10:100 ratio softened to a debated rule of thumb; rule-of-three cadences broken; aphoristic closer replaced
Broken link repaired, two missing citations added
Author credibility hook restored to the opening
First approval published raw research notes and a broken LLM preamble; replaced with the approved draft

_expect_doc: expect keys: before_errors (gate error checks the shipped text must raise), after_errors_empty, before_published_errors (errors in published=True mode), before_finding_substr / after_finding_absent_substr (substrings of advisory findings), findings_decrease, links_increase, words_increase_pct. gate_detectable=false marks cases only an LLM seat (L1/L2) can catch; the harness reports that partition so drift is visible.
